critique: The collision of Lichtenstein-esque primary-colored comic bursts with geometric koi fish orbiting a spinning vinyl record delivers a delightfully joyful and unexpected pop-art collage. However, the reliance on an external video asset within the record's center mask breaks the generative immersion; replacing it with a code-driven WebGL fluid simulation or an overgrown algorithmic mandala would better unify the cyber-nature aesthetic.
